Method of Attack: Infecting computers to gain boot persistence
Establishing communication with C&C server via IRC channel
Receiving commands via IRC to control infected machines
Uploading stolen data to FTP server
Sending emails with execution and error reports
Impacted Systems: Windows computers infected by GhostAdmin malware
Attack Vector: Malware infection leading to IRC-based command and control
Indicators of Compromise: IRC channel used for command and control
FTP server storing stolen screenshots, audio recordings, keystrokes, and victim data
Email credentials used to send execution and error reports
368GB of data stolen from an Internet cafe
Database stolen from a lottery company containing personal information
